class.name: VertexAIContext
class.brief_description: Aggregated context the Vertex AI assistant reasons over.
class.description: VertexAIContext gathers a nested dictionary describing the project: file structure, scripts, scenes, shaders, assets, and an error log section. Use [method build_from_project] to populate it, then pass it to a backend or inspect it via [method to_dictionary].

method.name: build_from_project
method.description: Walks the project filesystem (up to a reasonable depth) and categorizes files into project_structure, scripts, scenes, shaders and assets sections.
